entity.name: Rohith Singh
entity.description: Creator and maintainer of Linea's open-source SDKs and wire protocol for production AI agents.

projects.name: Linea SDKs and protocol
projects.description: The open-source (Apache-2.0) SDKs, wire protocol and examples for Linea, a hosted platform for building and operating production AI agents. The repository has server, browser, native and React SDKs, webhook verification, the schemas of the versioned /v1 API with an OpenAPI description, and working example applications. The platform the SDKs call (dashboard, API and workers) is not open source, and the SDKs are not on npm yet.
